properties.name: Thickness
properties.description: Wall thickness. 0 builds the air space as a solid body instead of a hollow shell

properties.name: TrimNeck
properties.description: Length of the straight collar between the fitting and the duct. 0 uses a quarter of the duct size

properties.name: BoxLength
properties.description: Casing length. 0 uses three times the largest duct size

properties.name: BoxWidth
properties.description: Casing width. 0 uses twice the largest duct size

properties.name: BoxHeight
properties.description: Casing height. 0 uses twice the largest duct size

properties.name: ConnectionOffsetY
properties.description: Moves the connection sideways from the middle of the casing face

properties.name: ConnectionOffsetZ
properties.description: Moves the connection up or down from the middle of the casing face

properties.name: LossMode
properties.description: How the loss is given: a coefficient K, or a fixed pressure drop from the maker's data

properties.name: LossCoefficient
properties.description: Pressure-loss coefficient K, referenced to velocity at the neck (0 = no loss at this connection; the fan's duty is read from the critical path)

properties.name: NeckSize
properties.description: Equivalent neck diameter the loss coefficient refers to. Used for the loss only, not for the shape

properties.name: PressureDrop
properties.description: Pressure drop in Pa at the design flow, used when LossMode is Fixed pressure drop
